# Pricing Plan

npm install @radix-ui/react-slot@1.3.3 class-variance-authority@0.7.1 clsx@2.1.1 motion@13.4.0 react@19.3.0 react-dom@19.3.0 tailwind-merge@3.7.0

npm install -D tailwindcss@4 @tailwindcss/postcss@4 postcss

Use a React + TypeScript project. Set up Tailwind CSS v4 with the @tailwindcss/postcss plugin (or @tailwindcss/vite for Vite). Copy these files keeping their relative paths. Import registry/demo.css once in your app. It contains Tailwind sources, theme tokens, and keyframes required by the example. Place public/media assets at /media on your server. The .dark class on the html element activates dark variants.

App.tsx is a working example; registry/demos/pricing-plans.tsx shows the component API. The DemoFrame helper only controls the example layout. You may remove it when integrating the component. Keep the copyright notices and the included license files.
